statement: Compute annual daylight metrics for occupied floor areas from a weather file with dynamic blinds: useful daylight illuminance bins, spatial daylight autonomy, mean illuminance and the share of time blinds stay open.

acceptance.corpus: LM-83 sample room, CIE 171 annual test cases, EPW for 3 climates
acceptance.tolerance: DA/UDI within 3 percentage points of Radiance reference; 500-sensor office under 30 s

statement: Compute annual sunlight exposure as the share of occupied floor area receiving direct sun above a lux threshold for more than a set number of occupied hours, with shading assumed fully open.

acceptance.corpus: LM-83 ASE test room
acceptance.tolerance: ASE area percent within 2 points of reference

statement: Compute illuminance on floor sensor areas at a chosen time from daylight, electric luminaires or both, returning mean and median per area and a false-colour map.

acceptance.corpus: CIE clear and overcast test cases at 3 times
acceptance.tolerance: Illuminance within 5% of rtrace at matched parameters

statement: Map annual discomfort glare as daylight glare probability at eight view directions per seated sensor, reporting the share of floor views that exceed a disturbing-glare threshold for a minimum share of hours.

acceptance.corpus: Office views in 8 directions, full year
acceptance.tolerance: DGP exceedance hours within 5% of reference

acceptance.tolerance: Visible sky fraction within 1% of analytic reference
